_doc: Golden fixture for controller_decision allowlist-only forced payload (cycle 7+ default-on). Forced under default-on (SAGE_ORACLE unset or true-ish); falls back to legacy redacted payload only when SAGE_ORACLE kill-switch is set (0/false/off/no/disable/disabled). cgpro 2026-04-30 cycle-7 VERIFY round-1 PUSH BACK: tightened to allowlist-only — free-form `reason` MUST NOT appear in the forced payload.
_invariants: MUST NEVER include raw node output text
Forced payload (default-on) is ALLOWLIST-ONLY: any key outside _allowed_in_forced_payload is a contract violation
Free-form `reason` parameter is dropped on emission; use slug-constrained `reason_code` instead
`reason_code` is matched against `^[a-z0-9_.:-]{1,80}$`; non-matching values coerce to `abstain_no_signal`
`quality_score` is clamped to [0.0, 1.0]; non-finite (NaN, Inf) coerces to None
